about: The name the chart key shows for each significant acquisition, keyed by the XBRL member headline.py finds it under. Read by hand 2026-11-02: the acquired company's name as the buyer's own 10-K prose writes it, with a trailing legal suffix dropped (as for company names). Quotes are verbatim from the filing named by accession.

deals.name: HD Supply
deals.quote: We believe the acquisition of HD Supply will help position the Company to accelerate sales growth by better serving both existing and new MRO customers.

deals.name: SRS
deals.quote: During the second quarter of fiscal 2024, we completed the acquisition of SRS, a leading residential specialty trade distribution company that sells roofing and complementary building products, landscape, and pool products to professional contractors.

deals.name: Actelion
deals.quote: During 2017, the Company completed the acquisition of Actelion Ltd through an all cash tender offer in Switzerland for $280 per share

deals.name: LinkedIn
deals.quote: On December 8, 2016, we acquired LinkedIn Corporation.

deals.name: Activision Blizzard
deals.quote: On October 13, 2023 , we completed our acquisition of Activision Blizzard, Inc.

deals.name: Liberty Property Trust
deals.quote: On February 4, 2020, we acquired Liberty Property Trust and Liberty Property Limited Partnership

deals.name: Duke Realty
deals.quote: On October 3, 2022 , we acquired Duke Realty Corporation and Duke Realty Limited Partnership

deals.name: Bucyrus
deals.quote: Our Resource Industries business was transformed by the acquisition of Bucyrus International, Inc. (Bucyrus) in July 2011, and now offers mining customers the broadest product range in the industry.

deals.name: Nokia's Devices and Services business
deals.quote: On April 25, 2014, we acquired substantially all of Nokia’s Devices and Services business (“NDS”).

deals.name: Bear Stearns
deals.quote: Effective May 30, 2008, BSC Merger Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of JPMorgan Chase, merged with The Bear Stearns Companies Inc.

deals.name: Washington Mutual's banking operations
deals.quote: On September 25, 2008, JPMorgan Chase acquired the banking operations of Washington Mutual Bank.
